lines.zh: 晶片相碰，我游过地下暗河。
lines.en: Crystal shards click as I swim the underground river.

lines.zh: 五条同伴跟在我尾后，队形不散。
lines.en: Four kin trail my tail, keeping the school unbroken.

lines.zh: 越深的洞，我的鳞越亮。
lines.en: The deeper the cave, the brighter my scales.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁游，晶体刮出细声。
lines.en: I hug the rock wall, crystals scraping a thin sound.

lines.zh: 水温降到发冷，我才觉得自在。
lines.en: Only when the water turns cold do I feel at ease.

lines.zh: 我从钟乳石缝里穿过去，鳞没碰一下。
lines.en: I slip between stalactites without touching one scale.

lines.zh: 火把光落下来，我立刻拐进暗处。
lines.en: Torchlight falls; I turn into the dark at once.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，游得像整条河都在动。
lines.en: This small body swims like the whole river moving.

lines.zh: 我们绕圈巡游，一圈比一圈低。
lines.en: We circle in patrol, each loop a little deeper.

lines.zh: 石缝里长着苔，我从来不吃。
lines.en: Moss grows in the crevices; I never eat it.

lines.zh: 我在水底悬停，等整群跟上来。
lines.en: I hover at the bottom until the school catches up.

lines.zh: 一米的纪录是同族，我只是半米。
lines.en: The metre-long record is my kin; I am half that.

lines.zh: 我离开亮水，往石下的黑里钻。
lines.en: I leave the bright water and burrow under stone.

lines.zh: 游过整条暗河，晶片一直在响。
lines.en: Crossing the whole dark river, my crystals never stop ringing.

lines.zh: 我们五条贴着洞顶游过。
lines.en: Five of us sweep beneath the cavern roof.

lines.zh: 晶片摩擦，声音像细碎的雨。
lines.en: The crystals click like fine rain.

lines.zh: 我拐了个弯，整群跟着拐。
lines.en: I turn, and the whole school turns with me.

lines.zh: 越往下游，水越黑，鳞越亮。
lines.en: The deeper I go, the darker the water and brighter my scales.

lines.zh: 我悬在石缝里，像一小截发光的冰。
lines.en: I hang in the crevice like a shard of glowing ice.

lines.zh: 晶体慢慢长，我什么也做不了。
lines.en: The crystal grows slowly; there is nothing I can do.

lines.zh: 水里没有声音，只有我的鳞在响。
lines.en: There is no sound here but my own scales.

lines.zh: 我数头顶的石笋，数到第十七根。
lines.en: I count the stalactites above me, up to seventeen.

lines.zh: 同伴都静着，我就跟着静。
lines.en: My kin are still, so I stay still too.

lines.zh: 我的身体透明，胃里那半条鱼看得见。
lines.en: My body is clear; the half fish in my gut shows.

lines.zh: 暗处有东西游过，我没转身。
lines.en: Something swims past in the dark; I do not turn.

lines.zh: 一天不游，晶片就会变钝。
lines.en: A day without swimming dulls the crystals.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，试了试水的味道。
lines.en: I open my mouth and taste the water.

lines.zh: 我们五个挤在石下，像一捧碎玻璃。
lines.en: The five of us huddle under stone like broken glass.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我顺着它晃。
lines.en: The current pushes; I sway along with it.

lines.zh: 没有光照到这里，正合我意。
lines.en: No light reaches down here, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我的鳍一动，晶体跟着颤。
lines.en: My fin twitches and the crystals tremble with it.

lines.zh: 静得太久，我开始想念水声。
lines.en: Still for so long, I begin to miss the sound of water.

lines.zh: 你的脸映在我鳞片上，被切成了几块。
lines.en: Your face in my scales is cut into several pieces.

lines.zh: 石缝外有张脸，我从里面打量。
lines.en: I study the face outside the crevice from within.

lines.zh: 你是来钓鱼，还是来捞我？
lines.en: Are you here to fish, or to scoop me up?

lines.zh: 你手里的那只桶，我认得。
lines.en: I know that bucket in your hand.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，晶体在你眼里反光。
lines.en: I stare, and my crystals glint in your eyes.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸搅动了水，我听见了。
lines.en: Your breathing stirs the water; I hear it.

lines.zh: 我在你脚下游了半圈。
lines.en: I swim half a circle beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，谁都不肯先动。
lines.en: We watch each other; neither of us moves first.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛比我见过的光都亮。
lines.en: Those eyes are brighter than any light I have seen.

lines.zh: 我又沉下去了，只留一片鳞影。
lines.en: I sink again, leaving only the shadow of a scale.

lines.zh: 我的鳞裂了一片，晶体掉了。
lines.en: A scale splits and a crystal falls off.

lines.zh: 别打，我的骨头都是脆的。
lines.en: Stop hitting; even my bones are brittle.

lines.zh: 疼从侧腹一路窜到尾巴。
lines.en: Pain runs from my flank all the way to my tail.

lines.zh: 我掉的那片鳞在水里打转。
lines.en: The scale I lost spins down through the water.

lines.zh: 这一下够我记一辈子，虽然很短。
lines.en: This will last my whole life, though that is short.

lines.zh: 血把周围的水染成淡红。
lines.en: Blood tints the water around me pale red.

lines.zh: 我往石缝里缩，只露尾巴。
lines.en: I squeeze into the crevice, tail still showing.

lines.zh: 同伴散了，只剩下我。
lines.en: My kin have scattered; only I remain.

lines.zh: 我身上有七点血，你算得出来。
lines.en: I have seven health; you can do the math.

lines.zh: 我游得歪了，晶体一直响。
lines.en: I swim crooked, crystals ringing without pause.

lines.zh: 那条生鱼的味道，穿过整片水。
lines.en: The smell of that raw fish cuts through the whole pool.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，眼睛只盯着饵。
lines.en: I circle you, my eyes fixed on the bait.

lines.zh: 虫子在钩上扭，我忍着不咬。
lines.en: The worm writhes on the hook; I hold back.

lines.zh: 再靠近一寸，我就忘了危险。
lines.en: One inch closer and I forget the danger.

lines.zh: 我的族人跟上来了，它们也闻到了。
lines.en: My kin follow; they smell it too.

lines.zh: 你晃那东西，我的鳍就自己动了。
lines.en: You wiggle it and my fins move on their own.

lines.zh: 我知道那是钩子，可我还是想看。
lines.en: I know it is a hook, yet I still want a look.

lines.zh: 让我闻一闻，我保证不咬。
lines.en: Let me just smell it; I promise not to bite.

lines.zh: 这水里没有比这更香的东西。
lines.en: Nothing in this water smells better than that.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就往前跟一步。
lines.en: You step back, and I follow one step forward.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的腿，像撞到一块暖石。
lines.en: I bump your leg like a warm stone.

lines.zh: 我的晶片磕在你靴子上，脆响。
lines.en: My crystals clack against your boot.

lines.zh: 别踩，我只有七点血。
lines.en: Do not step on me; I have only seven health.

lines.zh: 你太大，我一时没绕过去。
lines.en: You are too big; for a moment I cannot get around.

lines.zh: 我被水推着撞你，不是故意的。
lines.en: The current pushes me into you; it was not meant.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了一片，飘在你脚边。
lines.en: A scale falls loose and drifts by your feet.

lines.zh: 我贴着你停了一瞬，是凉的。
lines.en: I rest against you for a moment, cold.

lines.zh: 这么点身子，撞你也不疼吧。
lines.en: With a body this small, my bump cannot hurt you.

lines.zh: 我赶紧退开，钻回石缝。
lines.en: I back away quickly and duck into the crevice.

lines.zh: 你一动，水就替我把路让开了。
lines.en: You move, and the water clears a path for me.

lines.zh: 我绕着同伴打转，晶体亮成一片。
lines.en: I circle my mate, crystals flaring into one light.

lines.zh: 我们在石下并排，尾鳍一齐摆。
lines.en: We lie side by side under stone, tails beating as one.

lines.zh: 水暖了一点，是春天来了吧。
lines.en: The water warmed a little; spring must have come.

lines.zh: 卵落在石缝里，像一小把碎晶。
lines.en: Eggs settle in the crevice like a pinch of crystal dust.

lines.zh: 我守着这窝卵，不吃也不睡。
lines.en: I guard this clutch without eating or sleeping.

lines.zh: 别的鱼靠近，我就横过去挡。
lines.en: If another fish nears, I slide across to block it.

lines.zh: 我们的鳞光对着闪，算是说好了。
lines.en: Our scales flash back and forth; that is the agreement.

lines.zh: 它游远了，我还会跟上去。
lines.en: When it swims off, I follow anyway.

lines.zh: 晶体在我们交叠的影子里发亮。
lines.en: Crystals glow inside our overlapping shadows.

lines.zh: 这一窝孵出来，暗河就热闹了。
lines.en: When this clutch hatches, the dark river will be lively.

lines.zh: 桶一沉下来，整条河都变窄了。
lines.en: The bucket comes down and the whole river narrows.

lines.zh: 我被舀起来，晶片撞着铁壁。
lines.en: I am scooped up, crystals knocking the iron wall.

lines.zh: 这么点水，够我转身吗？
lines.en: This little water, is it enough to turn around?

lines.zh: 你提着桶走，我跟着晃。
lines.en: You carry the bucket; I sway along with it.

lines.zh: 别把我放在太阳底下。
lines.en: Do not leave me out under the sun.

lines.zh: 我在桶里绕圈，找一条不存在的出口。
lines.en: I circle the bucket, hunting an exit that is not there.

lines.zh: 水洒出去一些，我更挤了。
lines.en: Some water spills; I am more cramped now.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声从桶外传进来，很闷。
lines.en: Your footsteps reach me through the bucket, muffled.

lines.zh: 到了新水域，先让我沉一会。
lines.en: In new water, let me sink for a while first.

lines.zh: 桶壁是凉的，比石头还凉。
lines.en: The bucket wall is cold, colder than stone.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就知道有东西来了。
lines.en: The water shifts; I know something has come.

lines.zh: 那不是鱼的味道，是铁和皮。
lines.en: That smell is not fish; it is iron and hide.

lines.zh: 我盯住那个影子，鳍收紧。
lines.en: I fix on that shadow and pull my fins tight.

lines.zh: 有东西在钩边打转，我记住了。
lines.en: Something circles the hook; I will remember it.

lines.zh: 我找到一小群虾，够五条分。
lines.en: I find a shoal of shrimp, enough for five.

lines.zh: 那东西比我大十倍，我数清了。
lines.en: That thing is ten times my size; I counted.

lines.zh: 我决定跟住它，但不靠近。
lines.en: I decide to trail it without closing in.

lines.zh: 同族先散了，我知道该走了。
lines.en: My kin scatter first; I know it is time to go.

lines.zh: 水里有一道血味，我循着去。
lines.en: There is blood in the water; I follow it.

lines.zh: 我把目标记在鳞里，游得很慢。
lines.en: I keep the target in my scales and swim slowly.

lines.zh: 我吊在你侧后，一直没走。
lines.en: I hang at your flank and never leave.

lines.zh: 你现在是我的目标，别回头。
lines.en: You are my target now; do not look back.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的影子，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I follow your shadow, loop after loop.

lines.zh: 距离刚好，再近我就跑。
lines.en: The distance is right; closer and I flee.

lines.zh: 那团血味还在，我没松口。
lines.en: The blood scent lingers; I have not let go.

lines.zh: 我盯得太久，晶片都热了。
lines.en: I have stared so long my crystals feel warm.

lines.zh: 你换气的时候，我就往前挪。
lines.en: When you surface for air, I move up.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不眨，鱼没有眼皮。
lines.en: My eyes never blink; fish have no eyelids.

lines.zh: 这条线我游了三遍，不会再错。
lines.en: I have swum this line three times; I will not miss.

lines.zh: 你停，我也停，水替我们数着。
lines.en: You stop, I stop, and the water counts for us.

lines.zh: 我咬你的脚踝，只留下一道白印。
lines.en: I bite your ankle and leave only a white mark.

lines.zh: 我的牙很小，可我真咬了。
lines.en: My teeth are small, but I did bite.

lines.zh: 晶片划过去，你的皮破了点。
lines.en: The crystals scrape past and your skin opens a little.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，我只想让你走。
lines.en: This does not hurt; I only want you to leave.

lines.zh: 我撞你膝盖，然后立刻退开。
lines.en: I strike your knee and retreat at once.

lines.zh: 七点血的我，也敢咬你。
lines.en: With seven health, I still dare to bite you.

lines.zh: 我咬着你的袖子往水里拖。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve and drag it toward the water.

lines.zh: 你缩手，水花溅了我一脸。
lines.en: You jerk your hand back and splash my face.

lines.zh: 就这一口，我不追第二次。
lines.en: Just this one bite; I will not chase twice.

lines.zh: 我撕下一点皮，味道太咸。
lines.en: I tear off a bit of skin; it tastes too salty.

lines.zh: 暗河里多了五条影子，是我们。
lines.en: Five shadows enter the dark river: us.

lines.zh: 我从石头缝里被水流带出来。
lines.en: The current carries me out of a stone crack.

lines.zh: 这里的水深不到十层，正好。
lines.en: This water sits above layer ten; perfect.

lines.zh: 我在陌生水域睁眼，鳞先亮了。
lines.en: I open my eyes in strange water and my scales light first.

lines.zh: 第一条同伴游过来，碰了碰我的鳍。
lines.en: The first kin swims over and taps my fin.

lines.zh: 晶体是从出生就跟着我的。
lines.en: The crystals have been with me since birth.

lines.zh: 这片水安静，没有鱼也没有钩。
lines.en: This water is quiet, no fish and no hooks.

lines.zh: 我们排成一小队，先绕一圈。
lines.en: We form a small line and circle once.

lines.zh: 我落进光里，又赶紧沉下去。
lines.en: I fall into the light and hurry back down.

lines.zh: 世界很大，我们只占半米。
lines.en: The world is vast; we take up half a metre.

lines.zh: 火烧过我，我的肉已经开始熟了。
lines.en: The fire passes over me and my flesh is already cooking.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，晶体碎了一角。
lines.en: I hit stone and a corner of crystal breaks.

lines.zh: 水太满，我的鳃来不及滤。
lines.en: Too much water; my gills cannot sift it fast enough.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀出水面，鳞全开了。
lines.en: The blast throws me above the surface, scales splayed.

lines.zh: 箭穿进水里，钉在我背鳍上。
lines.en: An arrow cuts the water and pins my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 魔法的光钻进鳞里，晶体亮了。
lines.en: Magic light seeps into my scales and the crystals flare.

lines.zh: 饿得久了，晶片长得更慢。
lines.en: Long hunger makes the crystals grow even slower.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我全身晶片同亮。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water; every crystal on me flares.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我的鳃合上了。
lines.en: There is no water in the void; my gills close.
